start.title: [TODO:it] Return to the Throne
start.text:
[TODO:it] Pharaoh sits cold upon his throne.
Aaron stands at your side.

choices.text: [TODO:it] Cast down the staff before him

hide_consequence.title: [TODO:it] Speak the Sign
hide_consequence.text:
[TODO:it] He sent you to show His power.
Do not silence the Lord here.

choices.text: [TODO:it] Cast down the staff before him

storm_consequence.title: [TODO:it] Do Not Walk Away
storm_consequence.text:
[TODO:it] Pride will not free your people.
Return and obey.

choices.text: [TODO:it] Cast down the staff before him

serpent_sign.title: [TODO:it] Magicians Match the Sign
serpent_sign.text:
[TODO:it] Their staffs become serpents too.
Yet yours devours theirs whole.

boast_consequence.title: [TODO:it] Not Your Glory
boast_consequence.text:
[TODO:it] He alone undid their craft.
Speak only what He gave.

to_the_nile.title: [TODO:it] Beside the River
to_the_nile.text:
[TODO:it] Pharaoh comes down to the Nile.
The Lord says: strike the water.

choices.text: [TODO:it] Wait for him to ask first

choices.feedback: [TODO:it] It is a sign, not a plea.

choices.text: [TODO:it] Strike the water with the staff

wait_consequence.title: [TODO:it] Now Is the Hour
wait_consequence.text:
[TODO:it] His word does not wait on kings.
Lift the staff and strike.

choices.text: [TODO:it] Strike the water with the staff

beg_consequence.title: [TODO:it] Not a Plea, a Sign
beg_consequence.text:
[TODO:it] He sent judgment, not a prayer.
Do what He commanded.

choices.text: [TODO:it] Strike the water with the staff

nile_blood.title: [TODO:it] Seven Days of Blood
nile_blood.text:
[TODO:it] Fish die. Egypt cannot drink.
Pharaoh's heart will not bend.

choices.feedback: [TODO:it] Speak the Lord's word, not yours.

mock_consequence.title: [TODO:it] His Word, Not Mockery
mock_consequence.text:
[TODO:it] Pride does not break a king.
Deliver the warning given you.

frogs_plague.title: [TODO:it] Frogs Cover the Land
frogs_plague.text:
[TODO:it] They fill the houses, ovens, beds.
Pharaoh begs you: "Pray for me."

choices.feedback: [TODO:it] Mercy is not yours to barter.

refuse_pray_consequence.title: [TODO:it] Mercy Is His to Give
refuse_pray_consequence.text:
[TODO:it] When a king begs, you carry it.
Pray as you were told.

silver_consequence.title: [TODO:it] His Mercy Is Free
silver_consequence.text:
[TODO:it] The Lord asks no payment from you.
Do not stain His name with greed.

pharaoh_lies.title: [TODO:it] The First Lie
pharaoh_lies.text:
[TODO:it] Frogs die. The land stinks of them.
Pharaoh's heart hardens again.

despair_consequence.title: [TODO:it] He Is Not Done
despair_consequence.text:
[TODO:it] His power has only begun to speak.
Lift the staff again.

swarms.title: [TODO:it] "This Is the Finger of God"
swarms.text:
[TODO:it] The magicians bow at last.
But Pharaoh will not yield.

choices.text: [TODO:it] Take pity and stop the signs
choices.feedback: [TODO:it] Mercy is not yours to grant.

boast_again_consequence.title: [TODO:it] His Finger, Not Yours
boast_again_consequence.text:
[TODO:it] It is the Lord they confess.
Do not steal what is His.

pity_consequence.title: [TODO:it] Not Yours to Stop
pity_consequence.text:
[TODO:it] Pharaoh's pride must be broken.
Deliver each word, in order.

livestock_die.title: [TODO:it] Cattle Fall in the Field
livestock_die.text:
[TODO:it] All Egypt's herds lie dead in dust.
Israel's flocks graze unharmed.

choices.feedback: [TODO:it] Boils break out on every man.

hide_wrath_consequence.title: [TODO:it] Do Not Hide
hide_wrath_consequence.text:
[TODO:it] He goes before you into the court.
Take the soot and obey.

boils_plague.title: [TODO:it] Boils on Every Man
boils_plague.text:
[TODO:it] Even the magicians cannot stand.
Still Pharaoh's heart is iron.

choices.text: [TODO:it] Curse the king to his face
[TODO:it] Warn of hail and fire from sky

choices.feedback: [TODO:it] There is no road back now.

curse_consequence.title: [TODO:it] His Word, Not Yours
curse_consequence.text:
[TODO:it] Judgment belongs to the Lord.
Deliver the next warning given.

choices.text: [TODO:it] Warn of hail and fire from sky

give_up_consequence.title: [TODO:it] There Is No Going Back
give_up_consequence.text:
[TODO:it] He has set you on this road.
Walk it to the end.

choices.text: [TODO:it] Warn of hail and fire from sky

hail_fire.title: [TODO:it] Fire Walks With the Hail
hail_fire.text:
[TODO:it] Crops, beasts, and trees are shattered.
Pharaoh cries: "I have sinned."

choices.feedback: [TODO:it] He will lie again. Be ready.
[TODO:it] The storm stops. So does he.

trust_consequence.title: [TODO:it] Pray, but Know His Heart
trust_consequence.text:
[TODO:it] Mercy still answers, even here.
Pray, and watch what he does.

locusts_warning.title: [TODO:it] Locusts Strip the Land
locusts_warning.text:
[TODO:it] What hail left, the locusts eat.
Pharaoh's own court pleads with him.

choices.feedback: [TODO:it] All Israel must go, with all.

choices.text: [TODO:it] Accept his offer to free some

side_servants_consequence.title: [TODO:it] To the King Alone
side_servants_consequence.text:
[TODO:it] Speak the Lord's word to Pharaoh.
Let his servants hear it through him.

accept_consequence.title: [TODO:it] Not One Will Stay
accept_consequence.text:
[TODO:it] All the people. All their flocks.
That was the Lord's word.

darkness.title: [TODO:it] Three Days of Darkness
darkness.text:
[TODO:it] No man rises. No fire is seen.
In Goshen, lamps still burn warm.

choices.text: [TODO:it] Steal from Egypt in the dark
choices.feedback: [TODO:it] He will give them favor in time.

steal_consequence.title: [TODO:it] He Will Provide
steal_consequence.text:
[TODO:it] What is given is better than stolen.
Wait for His hand to act.

final_threat.title: [TODO:it] "Never See My Face Again"
final_threat.text:
[TODO:it] Pharaoh banishes you in fury.
One plague remains, the worst of all.

choices.feedback: [TODO:it] His heart is set in stone.

choices.text: [TODO:it] Warn of the firstborn at midnight
choices.feedback: [TODO:it] You leave the hall in flame.

beg_again_consequence.title: [TODO:it] Speak the Last Word
beg_again_consequence.text:
[TODO:it] He will not hear pleas now.
Deliver the final warning.

choices.text: [TODO:it] Warn of the firstborn at midnight

victory_consequence.title: [TODO:it] Not Yet
victory_consequence.text:
[TODO:it] The deepest hour is still to come.
Deliver the warning given.

choices.text: [TODO:it] Warn of the firstborn at midnight

ending.title: [TODO:it] Toward the Night
ending.text:
[TODO:it] Egypt is broken. Israel waits.
The last and longest night draws near.
